rows.note: Every active establishment, employers or not; Paris, Lyon and Marseille with their arrondissements summed. The section is the APE code's division grouped as NAF rév. 2 defines it; 1 establishments coded in an older nomenclature or uncoded are in no section. Holding companies and domiciled offices are counted where registered.
